books.title: Geometric measure theory and variational problems: a first reading
books.author: Stack Project of Geometric Measure Theory and Variational Problems contributors
books.description: Original exposition connecting classical GMT with minimal surfaces, elliptic regularity, tangent cones, Allard regularity, Almgren-Pitts min-max theory, the volume spectrum, CMC problems, and Allen-Cahn theory. Smooth mean curvature flow includes shrinking models and Gaussian area; obstacle problems remain introductory. The source inventory identifies supplied editions and checked passages. Cited theorems without local proofs are marked in the text.
